Name: (CP) Valentine's Day Furniture
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[size=3]I was surprised that a mod like this didn't already exist... So I went ahead and did it myself, or at least made a few things :)

This mod [i]adds[/i] exactly 71 (why 71 I don't know) furniture pieces to the game using Content Patcher.

There are currently four 'swatches' or color sets:
>Light Pink
>Pink
>Peach
>Plum
>Red/Rich Red
As well as a few other combined things based on the palette :) 

You can find the furniture in the general furniture catalogue that you can buy from Robin.

Alternatively you can install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] and use the Valentine Furniture Catalogue to purchase the items (you can also buy that from Robin)

You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] and type in "Valentine" to find the furniture.

To edit configs use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.

If you have any other suggestions I can try to make them!

[b]For Translators: [/b]
You may upload your translation file to Nexus, just be sure to make this mod a requirement + don't upload the actual code!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.

[/b][/size][b]Credits: [/b]
Just Concerned Ape because I would not know where to start with pixel art with out him :)
